# ForMash3D

ForMash3D is an open-source, self-hosted AI 3D generation and asset creation platform. It combines multiple 3D model integrations with GPU-aware execution and production-oriented asset processing.

## Core capabilities
- Image-to-3D and text-to-3D generation.
- PBR texture generation and painting with Hunyuan3D-Paint-v2-1.
- Mesh repair, decimation, UV processing, adaptive AutoRetopo and LOD generation.
- Physics collision artifacts and browser-side Rapier preview.
- Automatic rigging with UniRig and motion generation with ARDY.
- Localized mesh editing through VoxHammer integrations.
- Immutable `master/source.glb` asset checkpoint.
- Structured game-ready asset delivery.

## Model integrations
The registry is maintained in `backend/config/models.yaml`. Major integrations include TRELLIS, TRELLIS.2, Hunyuan3D, TripoSR, TripoSG, TripoSF, PartPacker, UltraShape, PartField, P3-SAM, FastMesh, PartUV, UniRig, ARDY and VoxHammer.
